title: Comic/Manga Page Interpretation via Vision-Language Models
description: An end-to-end pipeline making comics and manga accessible to visually impaired readers through screen-reader integration. Developed prompt-engineering strategies for VLMs that improved page-level comprehension accuracy by 40%, and benchmarked six vision-language models (MiniCPM, Qwen 2.5, LLaVA 1.6, InstructBLIP, CogVLM, Idefics3) on hallucination metrics.
